content.title: Question to Machine-State Proof | Remote Status Relay and Return
content.summary: Anchor one person's functional question to a visibly operating device, let a second adult check an independent status carrier, then return to the original device space. Close with one readable machine-state change and one human response instead of relying on small UI copy or prescribed dialogue.

quick_start.input_format: questioner and operating device in one frame + second adult with independent status carrier + no dependence on small UI text or exact dialogue + return to the original device space + one machine-state change and one human response
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult greenhouse supervisor stands beside an irrigation rack with one amber lamp and three empty transparent tubes. A remote agronomist checks a physical status tile and confirms once; back at the same rack, the lamp turns green, the tubes fill from left to right and the supervisor relaxes one guarded hand.
required_anchors: Open with the questioner and the relevant operating device visible in one spatial relationship.
Use a second adult and one separate status carrier as an independent response channel.
Return to the opening device space after the response.
Change one device state and one human response before the final hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Anchor one person's functional question to a visibly operating device, let a second adult check an independent status carrier, then return to the original device space. Close with one readable machine-state change and one human response instead of relying on small UI copy or prescribed dialogue.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Place one original questioner and one visibly operating device in the same opening frame so the functional uncertainty has a physical anchor. Cut once to a second adult who checks a separate status carrier and gives a visible response; do not rely on unreadable UI or prescribed dialogue. Return to the opening device space and change one machine state plus the questioner's posture or expression, so device evidence and human interpretation close the loop together. The reusable mechanism is question, remote status check, machine-state proof and return—not the source people, faces, clothes, home, computer hardware, phone, product, logo, dialogue, exact gestures, composition, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Open with the questioner and the relevant operating device visible in one spatial relationship.
invariants.purpose: Gives the abstract function a concrete proof anchor before any answer.
invariants.ablation_failure: A face-only question leaves later device evidence unbound.

invariants.rule: Use a second adult and one separate status carrier as an independent response channel.
invariants.purpose: Turns the answer into an observable relay rather than a title card.
invariants.ablation_failure: Keeping every claim with the first person collapses question and proof into assertion.

invariants.rule: Avoid depending on small interface text or exact spoken words.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the mechanism supported by visible state and performance evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unreadable UI or untranscribed dialogue cannot carry the causal claim.

invariants.rule: Return to the opening device space after the response.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the remote interpretation to the original physical system.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on the phone makes the machine's result ambiguous.

invariants.rule: Change one device state and one human response before the final hold.
invariants.purpose: Provides both functional and social confirmation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A static machine or unchanged questioner does not resolve the setup.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adults, faces, bodies, clothing, expressions and exact gestures
the source domestic rooms, balcony door, desktop computer, monitor, phone, couch and furniture
the source product, deAPI and Earn Module concepts, logos, interface state and copy
the source dialogue implication, camera positions, edit timing, color grade and performance rhythm
the source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
